name: HashiCorp Boundary
description: Manages secure, identity-based access to dynamic infrastructure without exposing credentials or network access.

envVars.description: Base64-encoded AEAD key used to unseal Boundary's KMS

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      BOUNDARY_POSTGRES_URL: "postgresql://boundary:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/boundary?sslmode=disable"
      BOUNDARY_KMS_KEY: {{env.BOUNDARY_KMS_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/boundary/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: boundary
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: boundary
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
